## Talk plan

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="68%"}
- Bundibugyo virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, fitted
  in Julia this summer
- What the parts have to do, and the ways we are trying to build them
- Six years of trying this in R
- What it would take, and the coding agents we run on instead

- Four questions I cannot answer
